meta.title: Maui Summer 2027
meta.dates: Jul 13–21, 2027 (FLL → Seattle → Maui · Grand Wailea · home via LAX red-eye)

route.name: Wailea, Maui
route.sub: 7 nights · Grand Wailea, A Waldorf Astoria Resort

blocks.title: Wake up & get ready at home
blocks.detail:
• 1 hr morning prep — dress, bathroom, last bags to the car.
• Night before (Mon Jul 12): kids asleep by 6:30 PM for 10 hrs of sleep — bedtime routine starts 5:30 PM.
• Breakfast is at the airport, after security.
• Kids' two backless boosters go in their backpacks.

blocks.title: Drive home → FLL (Hibiscus Garage, Terminal 2)
blocks.detail:
• ~45 min incl. the garage ramps at this hour.
• Delta flies from Terminal 2 — Hibiscus Garage is the one connected to Terminals 1–2.

blocks.title: Park — FLL Hibiscus Garage, long-term levels 3–7
blocks.detail:
• Long-term rate: $20/day max (incl. tax).
• Note the level and row — you return on a 6:52 AM red-eye.
blocks.notes:
• Parked Tue Jul 13 ~6:15 AM → exit Wed Jul 21 ~7:45 AM = 8 full days + ~1.5 hrs.
• 8 × $20 = $160 + ~6 × $2 (20-min intervals) ≈ $172. Estimate.
• Rate source: Broward County Aviation Dept (FLL) parking page.

blocks.title: Walk to Terminal 2 with bags
blocks.detail: • 3 large checked bags, 1 carry-on, 2 backpacks, umbrella stroller.

blocks.title: Delta bag drop + TSA
blocks.detail:
• Check the 3 large bags at the Delta counter (tagged through to OGG).
• Umbrella stroller: keep it and gate-check it at the jet bridge.
• Arriving ~2 hrs before departure for a family of 4 with checked bags.

blocks.title: Breakfast — FLL Terminal 2 (airside, restaurant TBD)
blocks.detail:
• Quick-service near the gate.
• Main Cabin on both flights is snacks only — real food is buy-on-board or what you bring.
blocks.notes:
• Estimate — restaurant not chosen, menu not checked.
• ~2 adult breakfasts + 2 kids' breakfasts.

blocks.title: Boarding — DL356
blocks.detail:
• Delta usually boards ~40 min before departure.
• Be at the gate by 7:35 AM.

blocks.title: Delta DL356 — FLL → SEA — Nonstop — 6h45m
blocks.detail:
• FLL → SEA, Economy (Main), 4 passengers, Airbus A320.
• Lands 12:00 PM Pacific (3:00 PM Eastern).
• Bags are checked through to OGG — no baggage claim in Seattle.
blocks.notes: • First leg of one connecting award itinerary. Points and cash for the whole outbound are logged on the SEA → OGG leg.

blocks.title: Deplane & walk into the terminal
blocks.detail:
• Family of 4 rarely deplanes first — full gate-to-food-court time.
• Collect the gate-checked stroller at the jet bridge.

blocks.title: Lunch — SEA airport (restaurant TBD, near the connecting gate)
blocks.detail:
• 2h 30m connection — sit-down or quick-service both fit.
• Pick something near the DL537 gate once the gate is posted in the Fly Delta app.
blocks.notes:
• Estimate — restaurant not chosen, menu not checked.
• 2 adult mains + 2 kids' meals.

blocks.title: Bathrooms, refill water bottles, walk to the DL537 gate
blocks.detail:
• Buffer before a 6-hour flight.
• Buy snacks for the second flight here.

blocks.title: Boarding — DL537
blocks.detail: • Be at the gate by 1:50 PM.

blocks.title: Delta DL537 — SEA → OGG (Kahului, Maui) — Nonstop — 6h16m
blocks.detail:
• SEA → OGG, Economy (Main), 4 passengers, Airbus A320.
• Lands 5:46 PM Hawaii time (8:46 PM Pacific / 11:46 PM Eastern).
• Hawaii stays on HST all year — 6 hrs behind Florida in July.
• Fill in the Hawaii agricultural declaration form before landing (handed out on board).
• Total outbound: 8:15 AM ET → 5:46 PM HST = 15h 31m.
blocks.flag: Not booked yet — book FLL → SEA → OGG (DL356 + DL537) for Tue Jul 13, 2027 on Delta SkyMiles.
blocks.notes:
• Outbound award as priced on seats.aero: 30.1K SkyMiles + $5.60 per person → 120,400 + $22.40 for four.
• 9 seats showing at that price.
• Whole itinerary (both legs) logged here.

blocks.title: Deplane & walk to baggage claim
blocks.detail:
• Collect the gate-checked stroller at the jet bridge.
• Bathroom stop before claim.

blocks.title: Baggage claim
blocks.detail: • 3 large bags — OGG claim is often slow in the evening arrival wave.

blocks.title: Tram to the Consolidated Rental Car Facility
blocks.detail:
• Board the tram across from baggage claim.
• Short ride to the rental car center.

blocks.title: Rental car pickup — Alamo, Chrysler Pacifica (or similar minivan)
blocks.detail:
• Use Alamo mobile check-in to skip the counter.
• Fold the third row flat — 3 large bags, carry-on, backpacks and stroller fit behind row 2.
• Install both boosters. Hawaii law: booster seat until age 10 unless the child is at least 4'9".
• 35 min: walk-around, boosters, loading bags, finding the exit.
blocks.notes:
• Estimate.
• Pickup Tue Jul 13 6:30 PM → return Tue Jul 20 by 10:30 AM (stays 7 rental days).
• Live quote seen Oct 17, 2026 on Discount Hawaii Car Rental: Alamo Pacifica $623.90 total, taxes incl., unlimited miles, free cancellation, pay at pickup.

blocks.title: Drive to dinner (Kahului)
blocks.detail: • Kahului is next to the airport — stay close, then one drive to Wailea.

blocks.title: Dinner — TBD (Kahului, on the way to Wailea)
blocks.detail:
• Restaurant not chosen yet.
• Pick somewhere quick with a kids' menu — body clock is past 1:30 AM Eastern.
blocks.notes:
• Estimate — restaurant not chosen, menu not checked.
• 2 adult mains + 2 kids' meals.

blocks.title: Drive Kahului → Grand Wailea
blocks.detail:
• ~17 mi, ~25–30 min: Mokulele Hwy (311) → Piʻilani Hwy (31) → Wailea Ike Dr → Wailea Alanui Dr.
• 5 min buffer for the resort entrance in the dark.

blocks.title: Valet — Grand Wailea (valet only, no self-parking)
blocks.detail:
• Valet only — no self-park option at the resort.
• Use the resort's free Wailea ride app for short hops instead of pulling the car.
blocks.notes:
• $65 per car per day (Grand Wailea official resort-inclusions page) × 7 nights = $455.
• + ~4.712% Hawaii GET ≈ $476.44 for the stay. Estimate.
• Not covered by the points booking.

blocks.title: Check in — Grand Wailea, A Waldorf Astoria Resort
blocks.detail:
• Lei greeting at arrival.
• Ask for a quiet room near the Wailea Canyon Activity Pool side if Garden View allows.
• Kids pick up their Grand Passport (on-property activity map) at check-in.
blocks.roomType: Garden View – 2 Queen Beds (Standard Room Reward), 2 adults + 2 kids
blocks.flag: 805,000 = 7 × 115,000 — confirm Hilton applied the 5th-night-free benefit (Silver+ on a 5+ night Standard Room Reward).
blocks.notes:
• BOOKED — confirmation 3115673578. Total 805,000 Hilton Honors points.
• Check-in 4:00 PM, check-out 11:00 AM.
• Resort fee ($50/night) is waived on award stays.
• Valet parking billed separately — see the valet block.

blocks.title: Bedtime routine
blocks.detail:
• Lights out ~10:25 PM Hawaii time (4:25 AM on the kids' Florida clock).
• Expect a very early wake-up tomorrow — Day 2 is a resort day with no fixed start.

days.title: Resort day — Wailea Canyon Activity Pool

items.name: Book the outbound award
items.note: DL356 + DL537 FLL → SEA → OGG, Tue Jul 13 — 30.1K + $5.60 pp on Delta SkyMiles (seats.aero).

items.name: Book the return award
items.note: DL463 + DL477 OGG → LAX → FLL, Tue Jul 20 12:45 PM → Wed 6:52 AM — 47.7K + $5.60 pp. Compare Jul 19/21 or an SEA routing first.

items.name: Reserve the minivan
items.note: Alamo Pacifica via Discount Hawaii Car Rental — free cancellation, pay at pickup.

items.name: Haleakalā
items.note: Daytime/sunset visit or skip. Sunrise needs a Recreation.gov reservation (60 days out) and a ~3 AM start.

items.name: Kahului dinner
items.note: Pick a quick spot with a kids' menu for arrival night.
